verses.greek: Τῇ δὲ μιᾷ τῶν σαββάτων Μαρία ἡ Μαγδαληνὴ ἔρχεται πρωῒ σκοτίας ἔτι οὔσης εἰς τὸ μνημεῖον, καὶ βλέπει τὸν λίθον ἠρμένον ἐκ τοῦ μνημείου.
verses.literal: the Now on the first day of the week Mary the Magdalene comes early when dark still it being to the tomb and she sees the stone removed from the tomb.
verses.dgt: Now on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene comes to the tomb early, while it is still dark, and sees the stone taken away from the tomb.

verses.greek: τρέχει οὖν καὶ ἔρχεται πρὸς Σίμωνα Πέτρον καὶ πρὸς τὸν ἄλλον μαθητὴν ὃν ἐφίλει ὁ Ἰησοῦς, καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς· Ἦραν τὸν κύριον ἐκ τοῦ μνημείου, καὶ οὐκ οἴδαμεν ποῦ ἔθηκαν αὐτόν.
verses.literal: She runs therefore and she comes to Simon Peter and to the other disciple whom was loving the Jesus and she says to them They have taken away the Lord out of the tomb and not we know where they have laid Him.
verses.dgt: So she runs and comes to Simon Peter and to the other disciple whom Jesus loved, and says to them, “They took the Lord out of the tomb, and we do not know where they laid him.”

verses.greek: ἐξῆλθεν οὖν ὁ Πέτρος καὶ ὁ ἄλλος μαθητής, καὶ ἤρχοντο εἰς τὸ μνημεῖον.
verses.literal: Went forth therefore the Peter and the other disciple and were coming to the tomb
verses.dgt: So Peter and the other disciple went out and were going to the tomb.

verses.greek: ἔτρεχον δὲ οἱ δύο ὁμοῦ· καὶ ὁ ἄλλος μαθητὴς προέδραμεν τάχιον τοῦ Πέτρου καὶ ἦλθεν πρῶτος εἰς τὸ μνημεῖον,
verses.literal: Were running now the two together and the other disciple ran ahead quicker the than Peter and came first to the tomb
verses.dgt: The two were running together, and the other disciple ran ahead faster than Peter and came first to the tomb.

verses.greek: καὶ παρακύψας βλέπει κείμενα τὰ ὀθόνια, οὐ μέντοι εἰσῆλθεν.
verses.literal: And having stooped down he sees lying there the linen cloths not however he entered.
verses.dgt: And bending down, he sees the linen cloths lying there, but he did not go in.

verses.greek: ἔρχεται οὖν καὶ Σίμων Πέτρος ἀκολουθῶν αὐτῷ, καὶ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὸ μνημεῖον· καὶ θεωρεῖ τὰ ὀθόνια κείμενα,
verses.literal: Comes then also Simon Peter following after him and he entered into the tomb and sees the linen cloths lying there
verses.dgt: Then Simon Peter also comes, following him, and entered the tomb; and he sees the linen cloths lying there,

verses.greek: καὶ τὸ σουδάριον, ὃ ἦν ἐπὶ τῆς κεφαλῆς αὐτοῦ, οὐ μετὰ τῶν ὀθονίων κείμενον ἀλλὰ χωρὶς ἐντετυλιγμένον εἰς ἕνα τόπον·
verses.literal: and the soudarion which was upon the head of Him not with the linen cloths lying but by itself folded up in a place.
verses.dgt: and the face cloth that had been on his head, not lying with the linen cloths but folded up separately in one place.

verses.greek: τότε οὖν εἰσῆλθεν καὶ ὁ ἄλλος μαθητὴς ὁ ἐλθὼν πρῶτος εἰς τὸ μνημεῖον, καὶ εἶδεν καὶ ἐπίστευσεν·
verses.literal: Then therefore entered also the other disciple the having come first to the tomb and he saw and believed
verses.dgt: Then the other disciple, who had come first to the tomb, also entered, and he saw and believed.

verses.greek: οὐδέπω γὰρ ᾔδεισαν τὴν γραφὴν ὅτι δεῖ αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν ἀναστῆναι.
verses.literal: not yet for they knew the Scripture that it is necessary for Him out from the dead to rise.
verses.dgt: For they did not yet understand the Scripture that he must rise from the dead.

verses.greek: ἀπῆλθον οὖν πάλιν πρὸς αὑτοὺς οἱ μαθηταί.
verses.literal: Went away therefore again to their homes the disciples.
verses.dgt: So the disciples went away again to their own homes.

verses.greek: Μαρία δὲ εἱστήκει πρὸς τῷ μνημείῳ ἔξω κλαίουσα. ὡς οὖν ἔκλαιεν παρέκυψεν εἰς τὸ μνημεῖον,
verses.literal: Mary however had stood at the tomb outside weeping. As therefore she was weeping she stooped down into the tomb
verses.dgt: But Mary was standing outside near the tomb, weeping. So as she was weeping, she bent down into the tomb,

verses.greek: καὶ θεωρεῖ δύο ἀγγέλους ἐν λευκοῖς καθεζομένους, ἕνα πρὸς τῇ κεφαλῇ καὶ ἕνα πρὸς τοῖς ποσίν, ὅπου ἔκειτο τὸ σῶμα τοῦ Ἰησοῦ.
verses.literal: and she sees two angels in white sitting one at the head and one at the feet where was laying the body the of Jesus.
verses.dgt: and she sees two angels in white sitting, one at the head and one at the feet, where Jesus’ body had been lying.

verses.greek: καὶ λέγουσιν αὐτῇ ἐκεῖνοι· Γύναι, τί κλαίεις; λέγει αὐτοῖς ὅτι Ἦραν τὸν κύριόν μου, καὶ οὐκ οἶδα ποῦ ἔθηκαν αὐτόν.
verses.literal: And say to her they Woman why weep you? She says to them Because they have taken away the Lord of mine and not I know where they have laid Him.
verses.dgt: And they say to her, “Woman, why are you weeping?” She says to them, “They took away my Lord, and I do not know where they laid him.”

verses.greek: ταῦτα εἰποῦσα ἐστράφη εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω, καὶ θεωρεῖ τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἑστῶτα, καὶ οὐκ ᾔδει ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἐστιν.
verses.literal: These things having said she turned to the back and she sees the Jesus already standing there and not knew that Jesus it is.
verses.dgt: After saying these things, she turned around and sees Jesus standing there, but she did not know that it was Jesus.

verses.greek: λέγει αὐτῇ Ἰησοῦς· Γύναι, τί κλαίεις; τίνα ζητεῖς; ἐκείνη δοκοῦσα ὅτι ὁ κηπουρός ἐστιν λέγει αὐτῷ· Κύριε, εἰ σὺ ἐβάστασας αὐτόν, εἰπέ μοι ποῦ ἔθηκας αὐτόν, κἀγὼ αὐτὸν ἀρῶ.
verses.literal: Says to her Jesus Woman why do you weep? Whom do you seek? She thinking that the gardener He is she says to Him Sir if you yourself carried off him do tell me where you have laid Him and I myself him will take away.
verses.dgt: Jesus says to her, “Woman, why are you weeping? Whom are you seeking?” She, thinking that he was the gardener, says to him, “Sir, if you carried him away, tell me where you laid him, and I will take him.”

verses.greek: λέγει αὐτῇ Ἰησοῦς· Μαριάμ. στραφεῖσα ἐκείνη λέγει αὐτῷ Ἑβραϊστί· Ραββουνι (ὃ λέγεται Διδάσκαλε).
verses.literal: Says to her Jesus Mary. Having turned around she says to Him in Hebrew Rabboni that is to say Teacher.
verses.dgt: Jesus says to her, “Mary.” Turning, she says to him in Hebrew, “Rabboni!”—which means Teacher.

verses.greek: λέγει αὐτῇ Ἰησοῦς· Μή μου ἅπτου, οὔπω γὰρ ἀναβέβηκα πρὸς τὸν πατέρα· πορεύου δὲ πρὸς τοὺς ἀδελφούς μου καὶ εἰπὲ αὐτοῖς· Ἀναβαίνω πρὸς τὸν πατέρα μου καὶ πατέρα ὑμῶν καὶ θεόν μου καὶ θεὸν ὑμῶν.
verses.literal: Says to her Jesus: Not Me do yourself touch not yet for have I ascended to the Father do go however to the brothers of Mine and do say to them I am ascending to the Father of Mine and Father of you and to God of Mine and God of you.
verses.dgt: Jesus says to her, “Do not hold on to me, for I have not yet ascended to the Father. But go to my brothers and tell them, ‘I am ascending to my Father and your Father, and my God and your God.’”

verses.greek: ἔρχεται Μαριὰμ ἡ Μαγδαληνὴ ἀγγέλλουσα τοῖς μαθηταῖς ὅτι Ἑώρακα τὸν κύριον καὶ ταῦτα εἶπεν αὐτῇ.
verses.literal: Comes Mary the Magdalene reporting to the disciples that I have seen the Lord and that these things He had said to her.
verses.dgt: Mary Magdalene comes announcing to the disciples, “I have seen the Lord,” and that he had said these things to her.

verses.greek: Οὔσης οὖν ὀψίας τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ τῇ μιᾷ σαββάτων, καὶ τῶν θυρῶν κεκλεισμένων ὅπου ἦσαν οἱ μαθηταὶ διὰ τὸν φόβον τῶν Ἰουδαίων, ἦλθεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ ἔστη εἰς τὸ μέσον, καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς· Εἰρήνη ὑμῖν.
verses.literal: When is being therefore evening of the day same the first of the week and the doors shut where were the disciples through the fear of the Jews came the Jesus and stood in the midst and He says to them Peace to you.
verses.dgt: So when it was evening on that day, the first day of the week, and the doors were shut where the disciples were because of fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the middle and says to them, “Peace to you.”

verses.greek: καὶ τοῦτο εἰπὼν ἔδειξεν τὰς χεῖρας καὶ τὴν πλευρὰν αὐτοῖς. ἐχάρησαν οὖν οἱ μαθηταὶ ἰδόντες τὸν κύριον.
verses.literal: And this having said He showed the hands and the side to them. Rejoiced then the disciples having seen the Lord.
verses.dgt: And after saying this, he showed them his hands and his side. Then the disciples rejoiced when they saw the Lord.

verses.greek: εἶπεν οὖν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς πάλιν· Εἰρήνη ὑμῖν· καθὼς ἀπέσταλκέν με ὁ πατήρ, κἀγὼ πέμπω ὑμᾶς.
verses.literal: Said therefore to them the Jesus again Peace to you even as has has sent forth me the Father I myself also send you.
verses.dgt: So Jesus said to them again, “Peace to you. Just as the Father has sent me, I also send you.”

verses.greek: καὶ τοῦτο εἰπὼν ἐνεφύσησεν καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς· Λάβετε πνεῦμα ἅγιον·
verses.literal: And this having said He breathed on them and He says to them do receive the Spirit Holy.
verses.dgt: And after saying this, he breathed on them and says to them, “Receive the Holy Spirit.

verses.greek: ἄν τινων ἀφῆτε τὰς ἁμαρτίας ἀφέωνται αὐτοῖς· ἄν τινων κρατῆτε κεκράτηνται.
verses.literal: If of any you may forgive the sins they have been forgiven to them If any you may retain they have been retained.
verses.dgt: If you forgive the sins of any, they are forgiven them; if you retain the sins of any, they are retained.”

verses.greek: Θωμᾶς δὲ εἷς ἐκ τῶν δώδεκα, ὁ λεγόμενος Δίδυμος, οὐκ ἦν μετʼ αὐτῶν ὅτε ἦλθεν Ἰησοῦς.
verses.literal: Thomas however one of the Twelve who is being named Didymus not was with them when came Jesus.
verses.dgt: But Thomas, one of the Twelve, the one called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.

verses.greek: ἔλεγον οὖν αὐτῷ οἱ ἄλλοι μαθηταί· Ἑωράκαμεν τὸν κύριον. ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Ἐὰν μὴ ἴδω ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτοῦ τὸν τύπον τῶν ἥλων καὶ βάλω τὸν δάκτυλόν μου εἰς τὸν τύπον τῶν ἥλων καὶ βάλω μου τὴν χεῖρα εἰς τὴν πλευρὰν αὐτοῦ, οὐ μὴ πιστεύσω.
verses.literal: Were saying therefore to him the other disciples We have seen the Lord. the But he said to them Only unless I shall see in the hands of Him the mark of the nails and shall put the finger of mine into the mark of the nails and shall put my the hand into the side of Him certainly not shall I believe.
verses.dgt: So the other disciples were saying to him, “We have seen the Lord.” But he said to them, “Unless I see in his hands the mark of the nails, and put my finger into the mark of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will certainly not believe.”

verses.greek: Καὶ μεθʼ ἡμέρας ὀκτὼ πάλιν ἦσαν ἔσω οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ Θωμᾶς μετʼ αὐτῶν. ἔρχεται ὁ Ἰησοῦς τῶν θυρῶν κεκλεισμένων, καὶ ἔστη εἰς τὸ μέσον καὶ εἶπεν· Εἰρήνη ὑμῖν.
verses.literal: And after days eight again were inside the disciples of Him and Thomas with them. Comes the Jesus when the doors shut And He stood in the midst and said Peace to you.
verses.dgt: And after eight days his disciples were inside again, and Thomas was with them. Jesus comes, though the doors were shut, and stood in the middle and said, “Peace to you.”

verses.greek: εἶτα λέγει τῷ Θωμᾷ· Φέρε τὸν δάκτυλόν σου ὧδε καὶ ἴδε τὰς χεῖράς μου, καὶ φέρε τὴν χεῖρά σου καὶ βάλε εἰς τὴν πλευράν μου, καὶ μὴ γίνου ἄπιστος ἀλλὰ πιστός.
verses.literal: Then He says the to Thomas do bring the finger of you here and do see the hands of Me and do bring the hand of you and do put it into the side of Me and not do be unbelieving but believing.
verses.dgt: Then he says to Thomas, “Bring your finger here and see my hands, and bring your hand and put it into my side; and do not become unbelieving, but believing.”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθη Θωμᾶς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Ὁ κύριός μου καὶ ὁ θεός μου.
verses.literal: Answered Thomas and said to Him O Lord of Mine and O God of mine!
verses.dgt: Thomas answered and said to him, “My Lord and my God!”

verses.greek: λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ὅτι ἑώρακάς με πεπίστευκας; μακάριοι οἱ μὴ ἰδόντες καὶ πιστεύσαντες.
verses.literal: Says to him the Jesus Because you have seen Me you have believed blessed are those not having seen yet having believed.
verses.dgt: Jesus says to him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed? Blessed are those who did not see and believed.”

verses.greek: Πολλὰ μὲν οὖν καὶ ἄλλα σημεῖα ἐποίησεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐνώπιον τῶν μαθητῶν, ἃ οὐκ ἔστιν γεγραμμένα ἐν τῷ βιβλίῳ τούτῳ·
verses.literal: Many indeed therefore also other signs did the Jesus in the presence of the disciples which not are written in the book this.
verses.dgt: So Jesus also did many other signs in the presence of the disciples that are not written in this book.

verses.greek: ταῦτα δὲ γέγραπται ἵνα πιστεύητε ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἐστιν ὁ χριστὸς ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ θεοῦ, καὶ ἵνα πιστεύοντες ζωὴν ἔχητε ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ.
verses.literal: these however have been written that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ the Son the of God and that believing life you may have in the name of Him.
verses.dgt: But these have been written so that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and so that believing you may have life in his name.
